_comment: v0.16 P2 (#307). Voice: character-profiles.md 'Den-Shop Keeper'. NEW graph on a NEW entity, so the loop and sign-off surfaces never ride a pinned hub.

hub.speaker: Den-Shop Keeper
hub.text: Come in, mind the small ones. If you're buying, the shelf is the shelf. If you're official, the counter's there, and I have had a long month of counters.

text_variants.text: The tin came up. Four cycles late and every stamp on it correct. Sit down, {addr}. You are eating something.

options.text: I'm here about a crate of tin.

month.speaker: Den-Shop Keeper
month.text: A crate of tin, four cycles late, and every stamp on it correct. The permit office cannot release it because the office is short its own supplies. Which are tin. I have hatchlings upstairs chewing yesterday's bread and a shelf with a tin-shaped hole in it.

options.text: That can't be how it works.

month_two.speaker: Den-Shop Keeper
month_two.text: It is exactly how it works and every single person in that chain is doing their job correctly. That is what visitors never believe. Nobody up here is lazy, {addr}. The clerk at the release window checks every stamp twice, both sides, and the dock behind her fills up while she does it.

options.text: Somebody has to be able to sign.

consignee.speaker: Den-Shop Keeper
consignee.text: I am the consignee. I can release the crate the moment somebody hands me a notice I am allowed to act on. I have been offered promises. I have been offered a shout down from the landing. A notice has a stamp on it. I am still waiting on the stamp.

options._comment: TALK route terminal rung. Requires the countersigned notice, i.e. offices 1 and 2 walked in order.
HELP route terminal rung. Three legs = the two carry props plus this shop's own receiving dock.
options.text: [Tell her the crate is already on her dock.]
I'll come back with something you can act on.

released.speaker: Den-Shop Keeper
released.text: Countersigned. The same office that held my crate in its queue for four cycles signed the release. I am going to have this framed and I am going to hang it where the hatchlings can see it.

options.text: Everyone in that chain was right.

carried.speaker: Den-Shop Keeper
carried.text: You carried it. Two tiers and three legs and no stamp on any of it. That is not how it is done and I am not going to say another word about it. Take the small jar. No, take it.
